messages:
Aisha Rahman: hey folks, onboarding Q — i got a hosted API key yesterday. running a quick smoke test: bulk embeddings (50 docs) + a few chat calls. after ~2 minutes the API starts returning 429s. i'm using 4 parallel workers. any advice?
DevEx Bot: welcome Aisha! common causes: embedding-unit rate limit, per-minute token/window limits, and concurrency limits for streaming connections. Check org usage: https://console.redwood.ai/usage. For experiments, sandbox keys are recommended.
Aisha Rahman: is there a single dashboard to see which limit I hit?
Marco P.: there's a usage breakdown per key in the console that shows embedding units vs gen tokens vs concurrent connections. If you hit 429s the response body includes a rate_limit and request_id — paste those into the quota ticket.
Aisha Rahman: got it. i'm not streaming, just sync calls. should i reduce workers or bump batch sizes?
Marco P.: try larger embedding batches first (reduce API calls) and drop parallel workers to 2. batching wins because embeddings have a per-call overhead but also hit embedding-unit rate; larger batches = fewer calls.
Rachel L.: also consider running the heavy vectorization on sandbox (separate key) so you don't consume hosted org quota. Sandbox is intended for offline/experiment runs.
Aisha Rahman: sweet. if i need a temporary dev bump, who do i contact and what info is needed?
ops-team: file the internal quota form: https://redwood.internal/forms/quota-request. include: project name, team, expected rps/tokens, models, whether streaming, timeframe, and paste recent request_ids + timestamps. cc @devex for faster triage.
Aisha Rahman: thanks — i'll switch the bulk job to sandbox and file the form if the smaller runs still 429. one more: does hosted quota differ by region? i'm on eu-west CI runners.
Marco P.: hosted quota is org-global but edge rate-limits may be applied per-region; if you need region-specific capacity ask for Dedicated or mention region isolation in the quota form.
Aisha Rahman: perfect, that helps a lot. thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
DevEx Bot: short checklist: 1) use sandbox for heavy offline runs; 2) batch embeddings; 3) reduce parallel workers or add jitter; 4) file quota form + include request_ids if you need a dev bump. :white_check_mark:
